summary: American grifters: the Krassenstein brothers, who promoted Ponzi-style investment schemes online before rebranding as anti-Trump Twitter figures, and teen fake hedge-fund manager Jacob Wohl, banned from finance and caught faking a 2018 smear of Robert Mueller.
keywords: How the People Trumped Ronald Plump

evidence.note: Krassensteins begin running HYIP promotion sites in 2003
2016 federal raids in Fort Myers and later DOJ forfeiture over wire fraud
brothers rebrand as anti-Trump resistance figures and partisan news site owners
Wohl starts an investment firm at 17 and courts financial TV appearances
NFA and Arizona regulators investigate his hedge fund and real estate firm
Wohl writes for Gateway Pundit and launches a news site with a plagiarised ethics code
October 2018 fake Mueller sexual misconduct accuser scheme with Burkman via Surefire

notes: Both the Wohl and Krassenstein halves get roughly equal weight per the title, so both are primary; roles describe both (Krassensteins also fit journalist-propagandist). Wohl birth year 1997 from general knowledge (transcript garbled); covered_span starts at birth per the lifetime rule though childhood is barely covered.
